name: BVP M-80
protection: Light aluminium/steel armour. Game: immune to small-calibre (5.56/5.45/7.62x39/7.62x51); 7.62x54R AP and larger can penetrate side/rear and disable tyres/engine; every launcher in the game list penetrates.
visual_notes: Low tracked IFV resembling a BMP-1 but with 5 road wheels per side
Small turret with 20 mm cannon and twin ATGM rails on the roof
Firing ports along the sides, two rear doors; M-80AB1 adds smoke dischargers and new optics
